items.title: #Cavs beat the Wizards 121-111 behind very strong nights from Evan Mobley and Peyton Watson. Cleveland's defense was awful in the 1st half but held Washington to just 42 points in the 2nd half. Mobley had 24, Watson had 22, Mitchell had 19, Harden had 16 and Thomas had 10.
items.author: Danny Cunningham
items.body_excerpt: #Cavs beat the Wizards 121-111 behind very strong nights from Evan Mobley and Peyton Watson. Cleveland's defense was awful in the 1st half but held Washington to just 42 points in the 2nd half. Mobley had 24, Watson had 22, Mitchell had 19, Harden had 16 and Thomas had 10.

items.title: Loving the hustle by Mario Hezonja and Peyton Watson when it comes to the defensive glass in the second half. Some aren't recorded as rebounds, but they are affecting the securing of those possessions. #Cavs lead it 113-105 with 3:28 to go.
